name: jerk
tagline: piano loop, blown-out 808, nobody is standing still
description: An internet-born microgenre pushed by Xaviersobased and his 1c34 crew: bouncy, lo-fi beats, chopped pianos and woozy, half-mumbled flows. Patchmade put it on the map, then Nettspend and Evilgiane's Surf Gang carried it onto every underground playlist.
